Little Alchemy 2 · Base-game recipe catalog

Theodore's Alchemy Recipe Book

Find an item. Explore its recipes. Follow the ingredients all the way back to the start.

720Items
3,452Recipe entries
3,308Different input pairs

Start with Air, Earth, Fire, and Water. Tap an item to see all its recipes; tap an ingredient to visit its own page.

Edition check: this catalog assumes Little Alchemy 2 to match the 720-item total. It excludes Myths and Monsters.

Time is special: unlock it by discovering 100 items. It has no mixing recipe.

About the catalog

Unofficial fan-made companion. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by the developers of Little Alchemy 2.

Compiled September 7, 2026. Includes all 720 items and all 3,452 distinct recipe entries in the cited source snapshot. Three repeated source rows were removed. Every ingredient reference resolves, and selected routes are acyclic. Recipes have not all been individually tested in the current Android app.

Reading the routes: both ingredients are required; the listed recipes are alternatives. A single pair can make several results. The suggested route is one valid dependency path, not a guarantee of the fewest moves. Reuse discoveries instead of rebuilding them. Time-dependent routes are conditional on reaching its discovery milestone.

This file works offline. Source links need an internet connection. Source recipe data: copyright 2022 mrkvon, MIT license. No original game artwork or descriptive encyclopedia prose is included.

Sources and qualifications
  • mrkvon / little-alchemy-2: game-recipe dataset — 720 item records, recipe ingredient pairs, and source unlock metadata.
  • Little Alchemy 2 complete item index and FAQ — 720-item base-game scope, four starting items, Time milestone.
  • Official Little Alchemy 2: Time — Time is unlocked by progress, rather than a recipe.
  • Official Little Alchemy 2: Item Types — Starting, unlockable, final, and depleted item concepts.
  • GambleDude: Bacon — Cross-check all four Bacon recipes and the 12-combination worked example.
  • GambleDude: Avalanche — Cross-check the 12 distinct Avalanche recipes after removing a duplicate source entry.
  • Source package MIT license — Source attribution and redistribution license.
  • User-supplied IGN guide — Identifies the original Little Alchemy guide supplied in the request.
